Title: If
Description: if / elseif / else. Branches are tried in order; a last branch with an empty When is the else.

Inputs.Description: Connect to the Body pin of a Passage, Option, Branch or Alternative. Statements run in the order of their links.

Outputs.Label: Branches
Outputs.Description: Tried in link order; the first Branch whose When is true runs. A Branch with an empty When is the else.
